label: The nine give every typed Dei Filius attribute, LIVING_1 from no POTENCY_1
meaning: At any being g with the nine, the registered nineGiveDeiFilius is applied with every one of its inputs except 'Whatever HAS_INTELLECT_1 is LIVING_1', on the primitives that agree with the given ones except that their Lives is HasIntellect; that bridge then holds trivially and nothing about the given Lives is used. Every conjunct except living is carried over. Among the nine is altogether immutability, whose body is that g is in potency in no respect (pure act). STMT-PURE-ACT-LIVES (derived in result PURE-ACT-LIVES-FROM-SELF-OPERATION from three open premises) gives g life at some time of the duration frame (LIVING_2), and the restricted sense bridge gives g LIVING_1, the living conjunct of the typed Dei Filius attributes. The two senses are not identified: the passage is the one listed bridge premise, restricted to pure act. Against nineGiveDeiFilius this route removes the intellect-gives-life bridge and adds STMT-PURE-ACT-LIVES and the new sense bridge. Conditional consequence only; no premise is established.
